hints.title: Single One Subarray Property
hints.text: Each valid split contains exactly one occurrence of the number one.

hints.title: Zero Gaps Between Ones
hints.text: Between two consecutive ones, the partition cut can be placed at any position among the separating zeros.

hints.title: Product Principle
hints.text: Multiply the differences between adjacent positions of ones across the entire sequence.

hints.title: Multiplication Code

complexity.notes: Single pass collecting 1-positions followed by gap product.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating combinations recursively is intractable when gap product solves it directly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear storage collects indices of ones.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the number of ways equals the product of distance between consecutive ones.
